newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq ends higher, snaps 2-session slide.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq ends higher, snaps 2-session slide.

text.p: Nasdaq stocks gained on Thursday in moderate volume, halting a two-session losing streak.
"The market does not want to go down," said Buzz Geduld, president of Herzog Heine Geduld. "There's money to spend. Institutions have money to spend, and they're spending."
The Nasdaq Composite added 10.14 to 1389.81. Winners outpaced losers by a margin of more than 11 to nine on volume of about 565 million shares.
Internet stocks were broadly higher after Intermedia Communications said it would buy DIGEX Inc for about $150 million. Intermedia jumped 1-3/8 to 28-1/2, while DIGEX added two to 12-7/8.
Shares of Carbide/Graphite Group Inc fell 4-1/8 to 24-1/4 after the company said it received a subpoena from a federal grand jury investigating price fixing by producers of graphite products.
Factory Card fell 3-1/16 to 5-13/16 after warning on Thursday that fourth quarter results would fall below analyst's expectations.
Novellus Systems Inc declined 2-1/4 to 75 after Salomon Brothers downgraded the stock to hold from strong buy.
